title: Expansion of a circuit into a tree
statement: For a Boolean circuit represented by an acyclic directed graph, its associated tree circuit is obtained by unfolding the output vertex and recursively copying the gates and their inputs.
hypotheses_covered: A DAG circuit on n input variables
The circuit's gates are in topological order and each gate reads only earlier vertices
The output is a vertex of the circuit
